basic_info.description: Step into this graceful NOPA condo in a boutique two unit building where original details and character blend  seamlessly with modern updates. The classic Victorian double parlor, complete with pocket doors  offers versatile living space options. Period details abound from  original hardwood floors and high ceilings to intricate moldings throughout.     The bright kitchen features elegant marble countertops, stainless steel appliances and ample storage. Enjoy the convenience of a private laundry room off the kitchen, perfect for a home office. The serene bedroom, located on the back of the property overlooks a lovely garden providing a peaceful retreat.    Located just two blocks from the vibrant Divisadero corridor, this A+ location puts trendy shops and gourmet restaurants at your fingertips. Enjoy easy access to Haight Street, Cole Valley, and Alamo Square. For outdoor enthusiasts, the Panhandle and Golden Gate Park are just steps away, offering tennis, pickleball, dog walks, and more.  Experience the best of urban living with a touch of nature right outside your door!    Walk Score: 93  Bike Score: 92  Transit Score: 90
